item.title: 【Live Audios (lossless)】WAV - Twenty One Pilots + Dayglow @ BMO Stadium, Los Angeles, CA 2025-10-26 (raw waves)
item.description:
One of the advantages of dating older women is it's a slim chance you will ever have to take her to see Twenty One Pilots. But it's never zero.

I hope someone got the Above Ground tribute to New York Dolls and The Cars at the Fonda. I wanted to go but my girlfriend really likes this band so yesterday I decided to take her here.

And it had to be Sunday. I could have got suite tickets for $75 each for Saturday. Which makes it a lot easier to distract myself from whatever is happening onstage. Like just pretending to be a total baller.

At least there was pyro.
